scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi Gramin Bhoomihin Krishi Majdoor Nyay Yojana
other_conditions: Original residents of Chhattisgarh are eligible
Only landless agricultural labourer families are eligible
The family must not own any agricultural land
Eligible occupational groups include shepherd, carpenter, blacksmith, cobbler, barber, washerman, priest and other similar categories
Families of persons who serve as worshippers (e.g., Pujari, Baiga, Guniya, Manjhi, Baja Moharia) in tribal places of worship are eligible even if they own land
Families receiving periodic allowance or financial assistance from other government schemes are not eligible
benefits_summary: A grant of Rs 7,000 per year is transferred directly to the head of the eligible family via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
